en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style illustration of a small cinema and theatre building with simple Art‑Deco lines. The façade is flat and symmetrical, with a central entrance porch supported by square columns and a balcony above. On the upper front, the word "CINEMA" is displayed, and beneath it is the name "TEATRU ADREANI". The building sits in a grassy area with a straight pathway leading from the foreground to the entrance, and there are low structures or fences on either side with trees in the background.
